These are repayments on notes receivable (economic development loans), not really revenue. 'other' with review is defensible; the user may want them treated differently. The same applies to detail[86] (Economic Development loan collections 2,914).

issues.on_page: Cemetery department (detail[38]-[45], total 37,418) = Public works 37,418 in the General Fund column on p5
issues.issue: Cemetery is a health/welfare function by the category list, but the statement on p5 counts it under Public works (streets/highways). The detail function split won't tie to the statement's functions.

issues.on_page: Cemetery: Rental and fees 10,003 (p2: Public works charges for services 10,003)

issues.on_page: Transfers (to) from other funds: governmental (29,686), business-type (175,465), component units +205,151
issues.issue: 205,151 of net transfers leaves the primary government for component units (CRA / Library Foundation). It is recorded as transfers, not spending, and there is no decision_needed entry. A person should decide whether money sent to a component unit counts as spending.
